35714-how-she-felt-in-her-first-corset-a.title: And Other Poems.
35714-how-she-felt-in-her-first-corset-a.creator: Matt. W. Alderson.
35714-how-she-felt-in-her-first-corset-a.description: A book by Matt. W. Alderson.. h a night  One should find a place there, and the lacing be tight. So the girl was rigged out as the mother desired,  But of dancing 'twas noticed the damsel soon tired. "What's the matter?" was asked by some one at her side. "I feel just like bucking," the maiden replied. Sweetheart of mine,  A valentine,  In duty bound, I send thee,  And wish that joy,  Free from alloy,  May evermore attend thee.

arxiv-2302-05888.creator: Hsuan Su Shachi H Kumar Sahisnu Mazumder Wenda Chen, Ramesh Manuvinakurike Eda Okur Saurav Sahay Lama Nachman Shang-Tse Chen Hung-yi Lee, National Taiwan University Intel Labshsuansu.96@gmail.com
arxiv-2302-05888.description: Abstract With the power of large pretrained language models, various research works have integrated knowledge into dialogue systems. The traditional techniques treat knowledge as part of the input sequence for the dialogue system, prepending a set of knowledge statements in front of dialogue history.

arxiv-2304-14079.title: Brownian Bees with Drift: Finding the Criticality
arxiv-2304-14079.description: Abstract \degree MMath Mathematics \degreedate Trinity 2023 Abstract This dissertation examines the impact of a drift \mu on Brownian Bees, which is a type of branching Brownian motion that retains only the N closest particles to the origin. The selection effect in the 0 -drift system ensures that it remains recurrent and close to the origin.

arxiv-2403-08904.title: Detecting Hallucination and Coverage Errors in Retrieval Augmented Generation for Controversial Topics
arxiv-2403-08904.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by . We explore a strategy to handle controversial topics in LLM-based chatbots based on Wikipedia’s Neutral Point of View (NPOV) principle: acknowledge the absence of a single true answer and surface multiple perspectives. We frame this as retrieval augmented generation, where perspectives are retrieved from a knowledge base and the LLM is tasked with generating a fluent and faithful response from the given perspectives.

arxiv-2410-05792.title: Classification of real nodal orders
arxiv-2410-05792.creator: Igor Burban, Yuriy Drozd
arxiv-2410-05792.description: Abstract . In this paper, we study properties of nodal orders defined over arbitrary base fields. In particular we give a classification of complete real nodal orders. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 16E60, 16G30, 14A22, 16K20 1. Introduction Nodal orders are non-commutative generalizations of the \mathbbm{k} -algebra \mathbbm{k}\llbracket x,y\rrbracket/(xy) , where \mathbbm{k} is a field.

arxiv-2504-04630.title: Foundation Models for Software Engineering of Cyber-Physical Systems: the Road Ahead
arxiv-2504-04630.creator: Chengjie Lu, Pablo Valle, Jiahui Wu, Erblin Isaku, Hassan Sartaj, Aitor Arrieta, Shaukat Ali
arxiv-2504-04630.description: Abstract Foundation Models (FMs) , particularly Large Language Models (LLMs) , are increasingly used to support various software engineering activities (e.g., coding and testing). Their applications in the software engineering of Cyber-Physical Systems (CPSs) are also growing. However, research in this area remains limited.

arxiv-2506-11414.title: Exponential Vorticity Hessian Growth in Capillary Liquid Drop in Two Dimensions
arxiv-2506-11414.creator: Zhongtian Hu
arxiv-2506-11414.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Zhongtian Hu. In this work, we concern ourselves with the evolution of a droplet of an ideal fluid in two dimensions, which has nontrivial bulk vorticity and is only subject to the effects of surface tension. We construct initial data with initial domain being a disk and initial velocity being arbitrarily small, such that the vorticity Hessian grows exponentially infinitely in time.

arxiv-2512-21191.title: Search for Light Dark Matter in Rare Meson Decays
arxiv-2512-21191.creator: Ze-Kun Liu, Ying Li, Biao-Feng Hou, Qin Chang
arxiv-2512-21191.description: Abstract Current dark matter direct detection experiments have low sensitivity to sub-GeV dark matter. In this work, we demonstrate that rare B B and K K meson decays with missing energy in the final state can serve as efficient probes in this mass range.

pmc-10609393.title: Fabrication of a Highly NO2-Sensitive Gas Sensor Based on a Defective ZnO Nanofilm and Using Electron Beam Lithography
pmc-10609393.creator: Zhifu Feng, Damiano Giubertoni, Alessandro Cian, Matteo Valt, Matteo Ardit, Andrea Pedrielli, Lia Vanzetti, Barbara Fabbri, Vincenzo Guidi, Andrea Gaiardo
pmc-10609393.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Hazardous substances produced by anthropic activities threaten human health and the green environment. Gas sensors, especially those based on metal oxides, are widely used to monitor toxic gases with low cost and efficient performance. In this study, electron beam lithography with two-step exposure was used to minimize the geometries of the gas sensor hotplate to a submicron size in order to reduce the power consumption, reaching 100 °C with 0.09 W.

pmc-11356157.title: Regular Physical Activity in the Prevention of Post-Transplant Diabetes Mellitus in Patients after Kidney Transplantation
pmc-11356157.creator: Karol Graňák, Matej Vnučák, Monika Beliančinová, Patrícia Kleinová, Tímea Blichová, Margaréta Pytliaková, Ivana Dedinská, Yuzuru Ohshiro, Kunimasa Yagi, Yasuhiro Maeno
pmc-11356157.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background and Objectives: Post-transplant diabetes mellitus (PTDM) is a significant risk factor for the survival of graft recipients and occurs in 10–30% of patients after kidney transplant (KT). PTDM is associated with premature cardiovascular morbidity and mortality. Weight gain, obesity, and dyslipidemia are strong predictors of PTDM, and by modifying them with an active lifestyle it is possible to reduce the incidence of PTDM and affect the long-term survival of patients and grafts.

pmc-11504710.title: Busulfan Chemotherapy Downregulates TAF7/TNF-α Signaling in Male Germ Cell Dysfunction
pmc-11504710.creator: Daoyuan Huang, Zhenbo Tu, Antoine E Karnoub, Wenyi Wei, Abdol-Hossein Rezaeian, Lennart Hardell, Atefeh Najafi
pmc-11504710.description: Background: Busulfan is an FDA-approved alkylating drug used in the chemotherapy of advanced acute myeloid leukemia. The precise mechanisms by which Busulfan kills spermatogonia stem cells (SSCs) are not yet completely understood. Methods: Using a murine model, we evaluated Busulfan-induced apoptosis and DNA damage signaling between testis and ovary tissues.

pmc-11699106.title: Neuroimaging signatures and a deep learning modeling for early diagnosing and predicting non-pharmacological therapy success for subclinical depression comorbid sleep disorders in college students
pmc-11699106.creator: Xinyu Liang, Yunan Guo, Hanyue Zhang, Xiaotong Wang, Danian Li, Yujie Liu, Jianjia Zhang, Luping Zhou, Shijun Qiu
pmc-11699106.description: ObjectiveCollege students with subclinical depression often experience sleep disturbances and are at high risk of developing major depressive disorder without early intervention. Clinical guidelines recommend non-pharmacotherapy as the primary option for subclinical depression with comorbid sleep disorders (sDSDs). However, the neuroimaging mechanisms and therapeutic responses associated with these treatments are poorly understood.

pmc-12581079.title: Poor health-related quality of life despite Lupus Low Disease Activity State or Definitions of Remission in systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) remission in patients with SLE: results from a clinical trial setting
pmc-12581079.creator: Ioannis Parodis, Julius Lindblom, Leonardo Palazzo, Alexander Tsoi, Nursen Cetrez, Henri Ala, Mandana Nikpour, Adrian Levitsky, Vibeke Strand

pmc-12706973.title: Age-dependent removal of Atg9-containing vesicle accumulations in motoneuron disease models by physical exercise
pmc-12706973.creator: Alexander Veh, Melissa Ewald, Vinicius da Cruz Neris Geßner, Neha Jadhav Giridhar, Amy-Jayne Hutchings, Christian Stigloher, Beyenech Binotti, Katrin Gertrud Heinze, Patrick Lüningschrör
pmc-12706973.description: BackgroundAtg9-containing vesicles are enriched in synapses and undergo cycles of exo- and endocytosis similarly to synaptic vesicles, thereby linking presynaptic autophagy to neuronal activity. Dysfunction of presynaptic autophagy is a pathophysiological mechanism in motoneuron disease (MND), which leads to impaired synaptic integrity and function.

pmc-12708867.title: General phase segregation and phase pinning effects in lanthanide-doped lead halide perovskite with dual-wavelength lasing
pmc-12708867.creator: Junyu He, Jun Luo, Biyuan Zheng, Feng Jiang, Tongqing Sun, Yaonan Xiong, Zhou Li, Jing Wu, Chenglin He, Jiahao Liu, Tingzhao Fu, Mengjian Zhu, Shulin Chen, Honglai Li, Mengqiu Cai, Zhihong Zhu, Fang Wang, Weihao Zheng, Xiujuan Zhuang
pmc-12708867.description: A strategy of lanthanide-ion doping into dual-halogen-alloyed perovskites CsPb(XxY1-x)3 (X, Y = Cl, Br, I) via chemical vapor deposition is introduced, obtaining a series of high-quality, stable microplates. Under continuous light excitation, each sample exhibits highly stable dual-band photoluminescence emission, whereby pairwise combinations of the three halogens enable photoluminescence to cover the red, green, and blue spectral regions.
